adaptationNotes: The full filter needs a source image, which the Holodeck runtime does not provide. Only the procedural pieces (shadow mask, scanline weighting) were extracted into snippets/crt-overlay to multiply over a scene's own colour.
name: CRT (Lottes)
notes:
[CRTS] public-domain CRT-styled scalar by Timothy Lottes (Unlicense), adapted for Ghostty by Qwerasd (gist c3da6c610c8ffe17d6d2d3cc7068f17f), preserved from 0xhckr/ghostty-shaders `85898f0`.

Post-process shader: warps and re-samples the terminal texture, then applies scanlines and an aperture/shadow mask. Not portable as a scene; mask and scanline math are reusable as overlays.

origin.author: Timothy Lottes; Ghostty adaptation by Qwerasd

requirements: pixel-scale mask tied to display resolution
summary: Timothy Lottes' public-domain CRTS scanline, shadow-mask and warp shader as adapted for Ghostty; source of the crt-overlay snippet.
